incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: Firefighters are battling a large fire engulfing a house, with thick black smoke billowing into the sky.

observations.description: Large plume of dark, thick smoke rising from the burning building
Bright orange flames visible through the windows and roof of the structure
Three firefighters in gear standing on a slope, operating a hose
Signs of fire damage to the house's exterior, including blackened wood and broken windows
A fence and a power line pole visible in the background
Green grassy hillside and trees surrounding the scene
